Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electronic Health Record Principal Sales Executive to drive revenue growth by helping healthcare provider customers adopt Epic on AWS and transform their healthcare organizations as part of this initiative.

Do you have a passion for building relationships with hospital system executives and helping them realize the business value of cloud computing and AI in support of patient care? Would you like to help set the strategy for helping provider customers get the most out of their Epic application, data, and patient care functions?

Do you have a track record of delivering strategic wins and exceeding revenue targets by helping provider customers drive compelling business outcomes? Are you energized by partnering with customers to position AWS as the platform of choice for mission-critical clinical, operations and financial healthcare systems?

Would you like to influence AWS's strategy on how we help our customers drive value in the Epic EHR ecosystem?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced and motivated sales/business development professional who aligns with our Leadership Principles and possesses a unique balance of healthcare industry expertise, is comfortable with C-suite conversations, and has consultative selling skills.

You will own strategy, key customer win goals, and revenue targets across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts, driving adoption of AWS services for Epic EHR workloads.
In collaboration with Solutions Architects, healthcare solution, business development, and partner teams, you will identify key customer accounts, develop account strategies, and lead/coach teams to win strategic multi-year deals.

As a trusted advisor to health system executives, you will help organizations build the business case for migrating Epic environments—including production, alternate production, integrated real-time environments (IRE), data and disaster recovery—to AWS.

You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a go-to-market strategy to build mindshare and accelerate AWS adoption within the healthcare provider segment, specifically focused on Epic EHR.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record of delivering strategic wins and meeting revenue targets while operating at the C-suite level for healthcare providers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value—including TCO reduction, operational resilience, and clinical outcomes—is critical.

You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about territory planning, competitive positioning, and long-term account growth.
We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following: Our company credo: "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with healthcare provider executives. You will have a passion for understanding hospital system priorities—cost optimization, operational efficiency, clinical innovation—and positioning AWS as the platform that delivers on those priorities for Epic EHR and associated clinical workloads.

Have a strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles in healthcare IT.
The ideal candidate will have past experience selling technology solutions to hospital systems, health system C-suites, and IT leadership. You will enjoy developing deep customer relationships and account strategies, leveraging your healthcare domain knowledge to earn trust at the executive level. You will regularly collaborate with Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and AWS service teams to bring the full power of AWS to bear on customer opportunities.

· Own and exceed annual revenue targets by driving AWS adoption for Epic EHR workloads across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts
· Coach and mentor sellers on how to develop winning Epic EHR and ecosystem proposals
· Develop and execute account plans that identify migration opportunities, map stakeholder relationships, and define a path from first engagement through close
· Build and maintain a robust pipeline through prospecting, executive networking, industry events, and collaboration with AWS partner and marketing teams
· Lead complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders—translating technical solution value into financial and operational business outcomes for CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, and clinical leadership
· Partner closely with Solutions Architects to ensure proposed solutions meet customer requirements and position AWS competitively against alternative hosting options
· Engage Systems Integrator (SI) partners to support deal progression, including joint selling motions, SOW development, and commercial structuring
· Negotiate and close multi-year commitments, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and migration-linked investment packages
· Serve as the voice of the customer internally—advocating for product enhancements, service improvements, and go-to-market investments that accelerate Epic on AWS adoption
· Build deep, trust-based relationships with senior executives within hospital systems (CEOs, CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, VP Infrastructure) to establish AWS as a long-term strategic partner
· Contribute to the broader AWS Healthcare sales community by sharing best practices, win/loss insights, and reusable deal strategies

Diverse Experiences — AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture — Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth — We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance — We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Field Sales Representative - Citrix Hunter

What You'll Be Doing
Identify, target, and acquire net-new customers within assigned territories through strategic outbound prospecting, account-based selling, and lead generation activities.
Build and execute territory and account plans focused on creating pipeline and driving new business opportunities for Citrix and related Arrow solutions.
Develop executive-level relationships with IT, infrastructure, cloud, security, and networking decision-makers to uncover business challenges and position value-based solutions.

Collaborate with marketing, business development, and vendor teams to execute targeted campaigns, follow up on assigned leads, and convert demand generation activities into qualified opportunities.
Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity, and activity tracking within Salesforce.com and other Arrow sales systems.

Promote Arrow's value-added services, professional services, lifecycle management, and supply chain capabilities as part of comprehensive customer solutions.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social selling, and account-based outreach strategies.
Experience selling infrastructure, cloud, virtualization, networking, cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology solutions.
Ability to communicate value to technical and business stakeholders, including executive decision-makers.
Strong pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity qualification skills.
Experience working with vendor partners and leveraging partner ecosystems to accelerate customer acquisition.
Proficiency with Salesforce.com, Salesloft, and other sales productivity tools.
Self-motivated, highly organized, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.

You have real sales skills and know how to close. This is a closing seat, and closing ability is the number one thing.
You have inside sales, phone sales, or SDR experience, with a real track record on the phone.
You handle objections on your own and ask for the sale, without sounding pushy or robotic.
You stay calm under pressure: when a customer pushes back or gets frustrated, you hear them out and respond thoughtfully instead of getting flustered or talking over them.
You communicate in confident, professional English at C2 level with a low accent, and sound natural on the phone.
You respond and follow through without anyone watching.
You keep the CRM clean and never let a follow-up slip.
You are the voice that turns warm customers into booked jobs. The demand is already there: customers call, the field team visits, and revenue gets left on the table when nobody follows up to close. This is not a cold-sales grind. You work from proven scripts, but you make them your own and sound human rather than robotic. You win the deal by handling objections live and guiding customers to yes.

Call customers and close deals, whether the opportunity is a service job or a larger project.
Handle objections live on the call and guide the customer to a yes rather than reading from a script.
Take the company's scripts, learn from them, and make them sound natural, never robotic.
Follow up with customers after each visit, capture honest feedback, and turn warm conversations into booked work.
Update the CRM (ServiceTitan) in real time with accurate records on every contact.

Experience in plumbing or construction, or a track record closing service and installation projects.
Formal sales training or coaching, with frameworks for discovery and closing.
Hands-on experience with ServiceTitan or a similar CRM.
Previous experience in a high-volume, phone-based, customer-facing role.
What success looks like
First 90 days: you are contacting customers and closing deals, ramped on scripts, and maintaining clean CRM hygiene.
Ongoing: you sustain a strong close rate month over month, meet conversion targets, and proactively surface and fix friction in the sales process.
Here is what to expect after you apply
You will get an email from Puente with a short online assessment and a quick grammar check.
You will record three short video answers so we can see how you communicate.
If it looks like a fit, our recruiter sets up an interview.
Shortlisted candidates are introduced to the US client team for final interviews.
This is a full-time independent contractor role, Monday to Friday 9 AM - 6 PM CT, 100% remote. Compensation ranges from $2,000 to $3,500 USD per month based on experience and performance. You will receive a company laptop and headset, flexible break scheduling, and clear monthly conversion targets that feed into performance bonuses.

This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

As a Sales Development Representative at ScraperAPI, you'll spearhead our outbound sales efforts for our premium web scraping solution. In this crucial growth role, you'll be responsible for proactively identifying, contacting, and qualifying potential customers.
Working within our enterprise Go-to-market team, you'll drive pipeline growth through consistent prospecting and strategic account based work.

This role is ideal for a motivated sales professional who thrives on the hunt for large accounts, needs the challenge of working multiple personas in one target account and wants to deploy their skills in a supportive, autonomous environment.

With a clear pathway to earning potential, strong performers are expected to quickly learn our target persons, own their territory plan and begin speaking to prospects within weeks. We're seeking a creative, driven individual who isn't afraid to think outside the box and make this role their own.

s.h: Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 weeks will be
s.t:
Master our product offering, ideal customer profile, and qualification process
Pick up prospecting your accounts, call them, develop relevant relationships, begin developing your pipeline
Use effective outbound strategies across multiple channels to generate qualified opportunities for enterprise-level clients
Learn from your high performing peers and work cross functionally with Ops and Marketing to optimise your territory outcomes

Generate leads through proactive outbound efforts including cold calling, targeted emails, and social outreach.
Research and identify potential customers that match our ideal customer profile.
Qualify prospects through discovery conversations to understand their needs and challenges.
Schedule meetings between qualified prospects and Sales Executives, providing context and insights that help maximize closing potential.
Maintain accurate records in our CRM, ensuring the sales pipeline is clean and organised.
Become an expert on ScraperAPI’s offerings and use cases to provide relevant, compelling information to prospects.

s.t:
At least 12 months of experience in a sales role, ideally in SaaS, tech, or B2B sales.
Strong drive, creativity, and competitive spirit with the ability to think outside the box
Professional fluency in a second language, alongside English, is highly valued.
Strong understanding of the sales process, with a goal-driven attitude and the resilience to handle rejections.
Experienced with CRM systems (HubSpot) and modern sales tools, as well as data-driven sales methodologies.
Interest in technology and ability to quickly grasp our product's value proposition

Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.
ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars.

With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella.

Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Aquatic Informatics (AQI), a Veralto company , is a mission-driven software company that organizes the world’s water data to make it accessible and useful. We provide software solutions that address critical water data management, analytics, and compliance challenges for the rapidly growing water industry.

We offer a full range of solutions, from standalone software packages for individual users, hosted software services, and enterprise-wide national systems.

About the Business Development Representative
The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for proactively generating new outbound sales opportunities from scratch within an assigned territory.
This is a high-activity, outbound-focused role where success is driven by consistent execution across calling, emailing, and targeted outreach. BDRs serve as the front line of our go-to-market strategy , identifying potential customers, qualifying needs, and creating high-quality opportunities for Account Executives.
Why This Role?
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in technology sales. You'll gain hands-on experience in prospecting, discovery, qualification, and territory management while making a direct impact on business growth.
If you're energized by outbound sales, enjoy building relationships, and want to grow your career with a purpose-driven technology company, we'd love to hear from you.
📍US or Canada. This role is 100% remote.

🚀 A strong foundation for building a long-term career in SaaS and technology sales
📈 Clear opportunities for growth into other commercial roles.
💰 Competitive base salary plus variable incentive compensation tied to performance
🎯 Performance measured through a combination of activity, pipeline generation, and opportunity quality
🌟 Opportunity for additional incentives and expanded responsibilities as performance grows
🌎 The chance to make an impact by supporting organizations that manage one of the world's most critical resources: water
🏠 A fully remote and flexible work environment with a collaborative and supportive team culture
🤝 Exposure to cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success
🌐 Access to career development opportunities across Aquatic Informatics and Veralto's global family of companies
💡 Ongoing coaching, training, and professional development to help you succeed

Prospect into assigned accounts and territories through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, and targeted campaigns to generate qualified pipeline.
Engage prospective customers, identify business needs and challenges, and conduct discovery conversations to assess solution fit.
Convert leads into qualified meetings, demos, and sales opportunities through consistent follow-up and relationship building.
Own and manage a defined territory, prioritizing accounts and maintaining accurate activity and pipeline data in Salesforce.
Track performance against key metrics and continuously refine your outreach strategy to improve results.
Partner closely with Account Executives to advance opportunities and ensure a smooth handoff process.
Collaborate with Marketing and Product teams to improve messaging, targeting, and overall go-to-market effectiveness.

1+ years of experience in a BDR, SDR, Inside Sales, or similar outbound sales role.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Environmental Science, or a related field preferred.
Experience in B2B and/or SaaS environment.
Proven success generating pipeline and achieving activity or opportunity targets.
Strong prospecting, discovery, and customer engagement skills.
Experience using CRM systems, preferably Salesforce.
Excellent communication, organization, and follow-through skills.

About Cargobase
Founded in 2013, Cargobase was created to transform how shippers and logistics service providers collaborate. What started as a solution to simplify spot-freight procurement quickly evolved into the leading enterprise platform in this space.
Today, Cargobase helps global enterprise shippers such as Bosch, Goodyear, Reckitt Benckiser, and Textron work seamlessly with logistics service providers including DHL, DSV, and FedEx. Our transportation management platform brings all parties together in a single interface, streamlining spot-buy freight from quoting and booking to tracking, invoicing, and analytics. Delivering transparency, efficiency, and control at scale.

As a SaaS Sales Development Representative, you are responsible for driving top-of-funnel performance by identifying, engaging, and qualifying new prospects to build a predictable and high-quality sales pipeline. You play a critical role at the start of the sales cycle, assessing customer fit, clearly articulating Cargobase ’s value proposition, and ensuring only well-qualified opportunities are passed to Account Executives.
This role requires disciplined outreach, strong qualification judgment, and consistent CRM hygiene. As the first point of contact for many prospects, you represent Cargobase in the market, strengthening our brand while directly contributing to sustainable pipeline growth and revenue impact.

1. Lead Generation & Pipeline Creation
Identify, source, and qualify new prospects across target industries and geographies.
Apply structured outreach via email, phone, and social channels to maintain a predictable inflow of high-quality leads.
Validate customer fit quickly using defined qualification criteria (i.e.use case, urgency, business pain).
Progress only leads to the sales pipeline to ensure quality and accuracy.

Maintain complete and up-to-date CRM records across all lead activities.
3. Introductory Solution Selling

Align prospect needs with core platform capabilities during early conversations.
Set accurate expectations to avoid misalignment during later sales stages.
4. Forecasting, Reporting & Target Achievement
Provide accurate forecasts on lead volumes, qualification rates, and conversion metrics.
Track outreach activities through CRM and ensure strong data hygiene for visibility to Sales Leadership.
Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified opportunities.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, or a related field (fresh graduates welcome).
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Organised, self-motivated, and comfortable managing a high volume of outreach.
Genuine curiosity about logistics, technology, or enterprise sales.

Comfortable in a fast-paced, multicultural, and data-driven environment.

A strong curiosity about how AI is shaping modern sales. Ability to write strategic emails and converse professionally with C-suite and VP-level executives.
A willingness to work with others across the sales team and a desire to help build the future of the Ceros sales engine.
A "start-up soul" that thrives in a changing environment with an ever-evolving AI-forward product.

About Dutchie
Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue.

Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.
Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.
About This Job
As a Business Development Representative on our outbound team, you'll find and open doors with dispensaries that haven't discovered Dutchie yet. You'll build target lists, run sequences, and start conversations that turn into qualified meetings for our Account Executives and Account Managers.

To succeed here, you'll need to be curious about the businesses you're prospecting into, resourceful when a first attempt doesn't land, and genuinely energized by the grind of top-of-funnel outbound — the volume, the research, the follow-up.
This role sits on a strong, growing sales team and comes with real coaching and mentorship as you ramp. You'll need to move comfortably across systems and adapt quickly as our outbound motion takes shape — prioritizing the accounts and activities that create the most pipeline. Your success will be rooted in consistent activity, sharp messaging, and a coachable mindset that keeps improving week over week.

Outbound Prospecting: Build and work target account lists across U.S. dispensaries, using state, license status, and market maturity to prioritize who you reach out to and when.
Multi-Channel Outreach: Run cold and warm outreach across call, email, and social, using the Dutchie Revenue Playbook to deliver consistent, proof-point-driven messaging that resonates with dispensary owners and operators.
Meeting Generation: Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and Account Managers, and manage a clean handoff so context and momentum aren't lost.
Pipeline Hygiene: Log activity, disposition, and source data accurately in HubSpot and Salesforce (Legacy and Greenpath), giving leadership reliable visibility into pipeline health.
Performance & Coaching: Hit weekly and monthly activity and meetings-booked targets, and show up for regular 1:1 coaching and Gong call reviews to keep sharpening your messaging and objection handling.
Market Intelligence: Share what you're hearing in the field — competitive signals, regional trends, buying triggers — so the team can keep refining how we target and message.

1+ years of experience in a sales, BDR/SDR, or outbound prospecting role, preferably within B2B SaaS or tech.
A track record of hitting activity and pipeline-generation targets in a metrics-driven environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to cold call and the ability to write outreach that doesn't sound templated.
Comfort working in a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and following a defined process for logging activity and disposition.
A coachable, growth-oriented mindset — you want mentorship from a strong team and a path toward Account Executive or Account Management.
Genuine curiosity about the cannabis retail industry and a willingness to learn the regulatory nuances that shape how dispensaries buy.
Organizational skills to manage a high volume of accounts and outreach without losing attention to detail.
It’s a Bonus if You…
Have prior outbound (not just inbound) sales experience and can speak to how you build and prioritize a target account list.
Have experience with sales engagement/sequencing tools and call intelligence platforms (e.g., Gong).
Have sold into retail, POS, fintech, or another regulated or vertical SaaS market.
Have exposure to or interest in the cannabis industry specifically.
You’ll Get…
We are targeting a starting salary of $50,000 - $65,000 based on the intended level for this role.
In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes:
Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care.
Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees.
Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance
Flexible vacation and sick days

Nylon is rebuilding how professional advice gets made. Not built for accountants and lawyers — built with them.
We work alongside firms that cannot afford to be wrong. They expect precision, speed and an answer they can put their name to, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our platform turns tax and accounting research that used to take hours into minutes, and powers the end-to-end workflow around it.
We are firmly established in the UK, working with tax and accounting firms across the country, with clients across professional services in Australia and New Zealand and partnerships with the professional bodies our prospects already belong to. We are now opening the United States.
Joining Nylon means three things.
We move first: high agency over waiting for permission, outcomes over intentions.
We hold the bar: direct, ego-free feedback and standards that do not slip when it is busy.
We learn out loud: what you work out on the phone today, the whole team uses tomorrow.
Small team. Real ownership. No passengers.
If you are driven by pace, mastery, and being early to something that is about to get very big — this is the place.

Own the phone. Cold call decision-makers at professional services firms and book qualified meetings for our sales team.
Open a new market. Work a UK-led patch that now includes early-stage outreach into the US — all inside a normal Brighton working day.
Run a tight rhythm. Call blocks, follow-ups and clean pipeline hygiene, executed the same way every day.
Learn the product properly. Our products are new and genuinely complex; knowing how firms actually get value from them is the job, not a nice-to-have.
Sharpen the message. Learn our ICP and messaging fast, then make both better through iteration and feedback.
Research like an analyst. Use trusted sources to understand prospects, personalise outreach and lift conversion.
Feed the machine. Share what you hear on calls so we can tighten targeting and positioning.

Extreme motivation to master selling. You want to be the best in the world at this, and you are prepared for what that takes.
High agency. You find the way through rather than waiting to be told.
A strong verbal game. Clear, concise, human — and comfortable being the first voice a partner hears that week.
Resilience. No does not slow you down.
Pace. We move fast, so you learn and adapt fast.
Coachability. You take direct feedback and apply it the same day.
Your academic background is not essential. What you can demonstrate is.
What's In It For You
Warm ground to work from. An established UK client base and professional body partnerships that put our name in front of your prospects before you call them.
A market to open, not just a patch to work. You will help build something from nothing rather than maintaining what is already there.
Front-row seat to the AI shift in professional services. You will be selling the change, not reading about it.
World-class training. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching on our own AI systems and modern B2B SaaS sales methods.
Commission earned on qualified meetings attended.
Peer recognition scheme and corporate discounts.
An in-person environment. A Brighton office built for people who want to be in the room.
Nylon is an equal opportunity employer
Great teams are built on a range of thought and experience. We welcome people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

About Linkup
Our Vision
We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.
AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.
Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.
Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.
Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.
Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.
Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

s.h: Our culture is built on the following values
s.t:
Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.
Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.
Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.
Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.
Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.
We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.
Our Team
We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.
